v1.13.0 SHIPPED 2026-04-23 (tag 9e8f98c). Release recovery narrative: initial workflow hit "Error creating policy" from softprops/action-gh-release@v3, Windows artifact dropped + release stuck in draft. Manual recovery: Windows uploaded, draft published, Homebrew formula pushed by hand. #95 closed with v2.6.2 pin-back in 3530787.

#96 SHIPPED 2026-04-28 via PR #98: re-pinned action-gh-release@v3.0.0 with continue-on-error attempt 1 + if:failure() retry. v1.13.0 transient could not be reproduced on a debug-tag rerun. Phase 4 CI is now empty for v1.14.0. See context.v113PolicyIncident for full diagnostic narrative + recurrence playbook.

v1.14.0 IN PHASE 3 (DESIGN + BUILD). Plan lives in project.v114Plan — read that for phased detail and remaining theme E issues. Soak-exit policy codified mid-cycle, see project.soakPolicy.

#99 SHIPPED 2026-05-05 via PR #104 (merge d9126b4). New src/projectResolution.ts chokepoint refuses auto-scope writes when project resolution fails; structured PROJECT_UNRESOLVED error with diagnostic. 22 files changed, behavior change beyond refusal — auto-mode project-then-global fallthrough on remove/alias-remove/confirm-remove also collapses (CHANGELOG breaking-changes entry). Tests 1325 → 1350 (+25). LLM_INSTRUCTIONS gained refusal-aware hint.

THEME E REMAINING: #100 (codex_context size budget — needs budget-default conversation), #101 (write-amp guard — warning-vs-blocking decision), #102 (audit project=. logging bug, small), #103 (tier semantics docs, small). #84 (entry health, milestone candidate). #99 was the root-cause anchor; the rest are smaller follow-ups.

DOGFOODING: docs/dogfooding-real-usage.md (part two + closure addendum) live alongside v1.13.0. Part three expected with v1.14.0 tag — natural narrative is "the loop closed and showed us a hole" + "we codified the soak policy from the same data".

NEXT SESSION LIKELY PICKS UP: triage remaining theme E issues. #102/#103 are small ship-anytime; #100/#101 each need a design conversation before implementation. Or, check open GitHub issues to see if anything new has filed since the merge.
